datasets.name: LMHLD (Large-scale Multisource High-resolution Landslide Dataset)
datasets.verbatim: LMHLD is open access and can be accessed through the link: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.11424987

datasets.name: RapidEye imagery
datasets.verbatim: For each study area, we compiled multiscene images sourced from the RapidEye, PlanetScope, IKONOS, Gaofen-2, and Sentinel-2 satellites.

datasets.name: HR-GLDD (High-resolution Global Landslide Detector Database)
datasets.verbatim: We use two additional datasets and a recent landslide event: the public landslide dataset HR-GLDD [12], CAS Landslide [22] and a landslide image triggered by an earthquake in Luding in 2022, collected from Planet data [60].

datasets.name: CAS landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: We use two additional datasets and a recent landslide event: the public landslide dataset HR-GLDD [12], CAS Landslide [22] and a landslide image triggered by an earthquake in Luding in 2022, collected from Planet data [60].

methods.name: Semi-adaptive patch size selection (SAPSS)
methods.summary: A method that selects optimal patch sizes for different study areas by analyzing the frequency histogram of landslide scale distribution, defining scale intervals via quantiles, and evaluating DL model performance.
methods.verbatim: Additionally, we propose a semiadaptive patch size selection (SAPSS) method, which adaptively selects optimal patch sizes for different study areas.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory LMHLD is linked and publicly available, while other input datasets are commercial or lack clear access paths. The custom SAPSS method code is not provided or linked.
